Each episode uncovers new dimensions of the conflict: the decisions that shaped the battlefield, the unseen networks that sustained the war effort, and the aftershocks that still shape our world today. "World War II with Tom Hanks" is the definitive retelling of that story for a new generation: a sweeping, deeply human portrait of how the modern world was forged in the fires of global war.

91108.title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
91108.originalTitle: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
91108.overview: Through heart-stopping stories, parents must come face to face with the horrible truth — that the child they loved has grown up to become a killer.

91116.title: Ricky Gervais Alley Cats
91116.overview: Curl up with a clutter of useless cats as they swear at the telly, debate life's most outrageous questions and cause chaos in the local community.

91118.title: El círculo
91118.overview: Four friends whose lives unravel after one of them posts a video implicating the Secretary of Defense in the murder of a famous actress. As they dig deeper, they find themselves entangled in a dangerous web of power, secrets, and betrayal.

91301.title: Cunk on Cinema
91301.overview: Philomena will be asking experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

91311.title: Legends
91311.overview: Surrounded by drug lords, a team of regular civil servants faces a nerve-racking undercover mission to take them down.

91342.title: History's Greatest Machines with Dolph Lundgren
91342.originalTitle: History's Greatest Machines with Dolph Lundgren
91342.overview: Machines can rewrite history – and no one knows that better than action legend and chemical engineer graduate Dolph Lundgren. Join him as he uncovers the stories behind history's most groundbreaking machines: witness secret stealth helicopters, spy planes outrunning missiles, espionage tech that won wars, to the rocket that took humanity to the moon. Guided by Dolph's keen insight and charisma, this is a thrilling ride through the gears, guts, and genius behind the machines that reshaped our world.

91371.title: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries
91371.overview: Cheryl Cooper escapes to an Amish community in Sugarcreek, Ohio, to manage a gift shop after a failed engagement. Drawn into one mystery after another, Cheryl quickly realizes her sharp instincts and outsider perspective are exactly what this tight-knit community needs.

91403.title: Make That Movie
91403.overview: Make That Movie focuses on a hotshot director, played by stand-up comedian and actor Sam Campbell who scours the country for everyday people who have an idea for a feature film. Sam and his team then race against the clock as they attempt to transform the idea into a film in just three days.

91405.title: NCIS: New York
91405.overview: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to their field office, partnering with a roguish agent and helping lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

91513.title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
91513.originalTitle: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
91513.overview: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers, a heart-pounding ride into nature at its most extreme. The series follows twelve teams of certified weather spotters and professional storm chasers as they self-shoot their close encounters with dangerous tornadoes. With no producers or camera crews, each team ventures into America's Tornado Alley, risking everything to spot tornados, warn people in harm's way, and help save lives when disaster strikes.The series captures raw, harrowing encounters as storm chasers, outfitted with their own camera rigs and advanced weather tech, race into the American Midwest during one of the most active tornado seasons in decades. These men and women risk their lives while redefining storm chasing for a new generation.

91584.title: Third Person
91584.overview: Chris, a young woman suffering from amnesia, is recovering and living with her loving partner, Nadia, after an accident four years ago. Everything seems to be going well, but then the arrival of a strange woman named Sun begins to shake Chris's beliefs.

91633.title: The Witness
91633.overview: From 2-year-old to teen, this coming-of-age drama based on true events follows the story of Alex Hanscombe who witnessed his mother's murder in 1992.

91636.title: New Zealand Spy
91636.overview: New Zealand's newest spies - and the only three who applied - are tasked with protecting our nation from incoming threats, most notably those noisy neighbours in Australia.

91758.title: Ann Droid
91758.overview: It's Sue's worst nightmare - an overly attentive, socially inept, second-hand robot carer. But maybe this droid has its uses...

91789.title: Newlyweds
91789.overview: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.

91830.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
91830.overview: Best friends Mordecai and Rigby work and live at a local park. Somehow, their mundane jobs always descend into surreal chaos, much to the annoyance of their boss and co-workers.

91854.title: Ride or Die
91854.overview: Ride or Die follows best friends Debbie Claybourne and Judith Burton who thought they knew everything about each other, except Judith turns out to be an international assassin. When a mysterious figure emerges from Judith's past and a hit goes horribly wrong, both of their worlds are turned upside down as they're forced to go on the run together. It's a race against time and a road trip across Europe, with law enforcement, highly trained assassins, and some very dangerous criminals at their heels.

91916.title: A Different World
91916.overview: They're young, gifted and Black — and ready for a freshman year they won't forget. Meet the tightest crew at the country's top HBCU.

91917.title: Human Vapor
91917.overview: When the Human Vapor announces a killing spree, panic erupts. A reporter and detective close in on the truth — and face Mufu, pulling society's strings.

91999.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
91999.overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

92001.title: Oasis
92001.overview: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

92003.title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
92003.overview: The series will serve as a companion to the original Adventure Time, featuring brand-new adventures for Finn and Jake that aim to "capture the spirit" of the show's earlier years. While Adventure Timewent on to include traditional, episode-spanning story arcs, Adventure Time: Side Quests looks as though it will contain far more self-contained adventures. The new series aims to introduce a new generation of fans to the world of Ooo while still appealing to older fans eager to jump back into the franchise they grew up with.

92037.title: The Evil Lawyer
92037.overview: When a principled young lawyer becomes the prime accused in the murder of a high-ranking police officer's son, he is forced to team up with the "Evil Lawyer," exploiting every legal loophole to prove his innocence.

92049.title: Spooky in Love
92049.overview: When a ghost-seeing heiress and an ace prosecutor discover that a single touch makes them an unlikely crime-solving duo, they team up to uncover unsolved murders. Cheon Yeo-ri, a hotel CEO haunted by spirits of people who died unjustly, joins forces with prosecutor Ma Kang-wook to investigate paranormal cases. As they unravel mysteries together, their strange partnership soon turns into something more romantic.

92113.title: The Man Will Burn
92113.overview: Since its beginning in 1986, Burning Man has grown from its anarchic counterculture roots in San Francisco to a globally recognized spectacle. Each year, 80,000 self-styled "Burners" congregate in the Nevada desert to create music, art, and connection, raise temples, join a spiritual movement centered on community, and take part in a modern American cultural experiment. Following the organization through several years of unprecedented turmoil, The Man Will Burn follows a movement pushed to its limits as it strives to stay operational while staying true to its core values.

92132.title: Bust Up
92132.overview: Bust Up follows former romantic partners Deb Brighton and Mihi Renata, who are unexpectedly reunited after a decade apart and forced to work side‑by‑side as police officers in the small (fictional) town of Waitote, the garden gnome capital of Aotearoa. Together the pair must navigate a series of crimes are as bizarre as they are dangerous, and as the stakes escalate, so does the emotional tension, pushing Deb and Mihi to confront the unresolved feelings they've spent years trying to bury.

92171.title: Proud
92171.overview: The story of Filip, a young and irresponsible gay man who lives with the conviction that the world belongs to him and that this will never change. He is brazen, unpunished, thoughtless, impatient, beautiful, and young. He compensates for his inner lack of self-confidence with arrogance, admiration in others' eyes, and a job as a model. When a family tragedy strikes, his entire world is turned upside down.

92181.title: Notes from the Last Row
92181.overview: A failed writer-turned-professor finds rare talent in a student's writing — and grows obsessed with his draft as their private lessons go off course.

92196.title: Anne Rice's The Vampire Lestat
92196.overview: The Vampire Lestat goes on tour while being haunted by "muses" from his past. As the band's popularity grows, so does Lestat's influence over vampires & humans alike, leaving others to contend with Lestat's power in the face of the Great Conversion.

92273.title: Morfeusz
92273.overview: Morpheus is the story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through an unfortunate turn of events, finds himself at the head of a gang. When young Leyer takes control of the organized crime group previously led by his brother—and before that, his father—it quickly becomes clear that he fits in surprisingly well with the underworld. The seemingly ordinary husband and father fulfills his new responsibilities with increasing effectiveness, slowly pushing the boundaries of morality one after another.

92274.title: Yani Neko
92274.overview: Welcome to Yani's apartment. Please don't mind the smell. Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Behind on her rent and unable to hold down a job, her friends and sister rally around to help her out. But when she's using her pee to put out cigarette fires, they may just have their work cut out for them.

92316.title: The Villager of Level 999
92316.overview: In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Koji Kagami, who is Level…999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King's daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.

92336.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
92336.originalTitle: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
92336.overview: The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he's reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!

92352.title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
92352.originalTitle: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
92352.overview: At the peak of his career, top celebrity Feng Qinglang escapes to a remote tea mountain, seeking a brief respite from the spotlight. Instead, he meets Xu Changyang, a free-spirited young tea farmer with an untamed soul. One belongs to the dazzling world of fame, the other to the forests and the land. As they grow closer among the mountains and wilderness, love quietly takes root. But the relentless scrutiny of the entertainment industry and the harsh realities of society soon close in, pushing them toward separation time and again. In the end, will they follow the call of their hearts and risk everything for love?

92448.title: The Season
92448.overview: A striving American is thrown headfirst into the world of superyachts, sun, and scandal over the Hong Kong boating season in this soapy delicious revenge thriller about the wealthy and the secrets they keep. Our story follows Coleen "Cola" Li, a summer associate for a prestigious financial firm, as her mentor introduces her to "The Season": six glorious weeks in the summer where the rich and fabulous host a series of extravagant events. During the opening party aboard a superyacht, Cola meets the important players in Hong Kong. All are beautiful. All are dangerous. All are keeping a secret. But Cola is as well. She's here to get vengeance for a past injustice, no matter the cost. Over six weeks, Cola must navigate the world of the 1%, as she infiltrates high society in their private boxes at the races, charity tables at boxing matches, murder mystery parties at amusement parks, as well as the seedier side of the rich. At the end, Cola faces a choice: do I destroy these people or become them?

92457.title: Worst Neighbor Ever
92457.overview: You think you know your neighbors? Think again. This new series features firsthand accounts of violence, intimidation, and harassment that are more shocking than ever. Through compelling testimonials, startling body cam footage, and animated reenactments, Worst Neighbor Ever proves the people next door aren't just a nuisance - they're lethal.

92492.title: Black Torch
92492.overview: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago's powers.

92554.title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne
92554.originalTitle: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne
92554.overview: A low-ranking prince scorned as incompetent. His true identity is—the seventh prince of the powerful Ardrasia Empire. Arnold, the seventh prince of this empire, was known as the "Dust-Drained Prince" because his twin brother, Leonard, was so talented that he had sucked everything out of him. In the midst of the intensifying struggle for the throne following the sudden death of the first prince, who was the crown prince, Arnold decides to get serious, thinking, "I don't want to die, so I'll just make my brother emperor." While playing the role of the incompetent "Dust-Drained Prince" on the public stage, he secretly operates with overwhelming power as "Silver," one of only five SS-rank adventurers on the continent, and controls the struggle for the throne from the shadows.

92590.title: De Eetclub
92590.overview: When Karen moves with her family to Bergen, they are warmly welcomed into the dinner club, a seductive group of friends who fully indulge in an extravagant and hedonistic lifestyle. Until one of the luxurious villas goes up in flames, and their friend Evert is killed. His wife and children barely survive. Karen soon discovers that their close friendship is held together by lies. Everyone has something to hide. Nothing is what it seems. So Karen sets out in search of the truth, but at what cost?

92629.title: The World's Strongest Rearguard
92629.overview: After a fatal accident, overworked office worker Arihito Atobe is reborn in the Labyrinth Country as a Seeker with the rare Rearguard class—an all-purpose support role that excels in attack, defense, and healing. Joined by a fierce demi-human mercenary and his former boss, Arihito dives into deadly dungeons and rises through the ranks. The adventure of the strongest support class begins!

92726.title: The Wargame
92726.overview: The Wargame takes viewers beyond the news cycle and behind closed doors into a sealed COBR-style crisis room where real-world senior politicians, military leaders and intelligence chiefs are challenged to confront a high-stakes scenario: a Russian attack on UK soil.Set six months in the future, this gripping simulation has been developed in conjunction with leading academics, military and defence experts, including Sky News' Security and Defence Editor Deborah Haynes, to replicate the pressure of political decision-making at the highest level.Rolling news bulletins, social media footage, military and intelligence reports and unexpected interventions throw up a series of minute-by-minute dilemmas, forcing the ‘Cabinet' to grapple with decisions that could affect us all. A provocative stress test on our leaders, our institutions and the country itself, this unmissable event television will prompt us all to engage with our new geopolitical reality.

92733.title: PSYREN
92733.overview: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "PSYЯEN." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

92743.title: Possession
92743.overview: Claudia, an ambitious young bi‑racial lawyer, travels to Jamaica to challenge an inheritance claim made by a local man, Cudjoe East, against Oliver Connaught, a wealthy white aristocrat. But the case takes an unsettling turn when Claudia discovers that the disputed estate is the very place that has haunted her nightmares: Hope Hill, the Connaught family's former plantation. As Claudia and Oliver dig deeper, they uncover a disturbing link between the plantation's brutal past and the injustices still shaping the present.

92747.title: Fool Night
92747.overview: A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother.However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope.Living... there isn't a single thing fun about it.In this dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of the "Spiriflor" — the plants that humans transform into.Should he continue living as a human being, or cast off his suffering and start a new life as a plant?Which path would you choose in his situation?

92751.title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
92751.overview: The Drop follows Wanda and Leon (from the original Snowfall series), who are now fighting to reinvent themselves in '90s Los Angeles, where the fallout from the crack epidemic is fueling a new game: the rise of West Coast rap.

92764.title: JAŸ-Z IN 8
92764.overview: 30 years after his landmark debut album "Reasonable Doubt," artist, icon, philanthropist, entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career, revisiting the music together and unpacking his work and life through a shared listening and illuminating conversation. Featuring many of JAŸ-Z's iconic tracks and album cuts, including "99 Problems," "Brooklyn's Finest," and "4:44," the eight-episode series offers a deeply revealing portrait of the artist and his work, exploring the influences and inspiration that shaped both the man and his music.

92766.title: The Wolf King
92766.overview: The Wolf King follows princess Aurora, after being abducted by a brooding werewolf alpha from a world that treated her as a decorative pawn, uncovering her own wild strength. Ensnared in a lethal love triangle, she is thrust into a bloodthirsty war between humankind and her feral captors, forcing her to decide whether she's a prize to be claimed or the master of her own destiny.

92789.title: Mousetrap
92789.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

92795.title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
92795.originalTitle: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
92795.overview: Elizabeth Leiston, the daughter of Haldoria's powerful prime minister, is the picture of a refined noble lady and the perfect future queen. But when her fiancé publicly humiliates her, calls off their engagement, and starts spreading nasty rumors about her, Elizabeth reaches her breaking point. Why should her only friend be her loyal maid, and why should she continue to serve a country that doesn't respect her? Elizabeth concludes she won't stand it any longer and will bring down the kingdom, even if it's the last thing she does! As such, she uses her quick wit and, more importantly, her seven magic grimoires to embark on a quest for revenge. And let her tell you, there will be hell to pay!

92838.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
92838.overview: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental S.W.A.T. unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city — and saving the program that made him who he is.

92844.title: Overgeared
92844.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

92854.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
92854.originalTitle: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
92854.overview: The war is over, and hero Dias is finally rewarded with land of his own—only to discover it's a barren frontier with no people, no villages, and no sign of civilization. With nothing but endless grassland ahead of him, Dias sets out to build a domain from the ground up. But after meeting Alna, a mysterious girl with a blue horn, his lonely frontier is about to spring to life.

92867.title: A Bona Fide Killer
92867.overview: Ordinary working mom Yu Bo Na is secretly the legendary assassin Kingfisher, who eliminates criminals beyond the reach of the law. Returning to work after three years of maternity leave, she resumes a perilous double life, balancing work, childcare, housework, and assassinations. As her missions grow more dangerous, a detective hunting a mysterious killer and a husband beginning to suspect the truth threaten to expose her secret. From school drop-offs to taking down criminals, every moment is a high-wire act with no room to slip up. The instant her true identity surfaces, she stands to lose everything. Can Yu Bo Na keep her identity hidden and protect both worlds as a loving wife and mother to her family and a ruthless killer to her targets?

92871.title: Balaraw
92871.overview: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

92878.title: Bone Parish
92878.overview: In the dark underworld of New Orleans, the Winters family builds an empire around a powerful new drug—crafted from the ashes of the dead—that grants users vivid, haunting visions of the past. But as demand surges, rival factions, deadly secrets, and supernatural forces close in, pulling them deeper into a violent and inescapable nightmare of crime, horror, and family legacy.

92905.title: GIGN
92905.overview: After an unprecedented attack on his elite unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

92984.title: El problema final
92984.overview: In the spring of 1959, thirteen people were stuck by a violent storm on a small islet near Mallorca. Any of them could anticipate what is about to happen at the small hotel where they're staying: Elisa Mander, a discreet British tourist, is found dead. What initially seems like a suicide soon raises unsettling signs—it may in fact be murder. Basil, a retired actor once famous for portraying none other than Sherlock Holmes on the big screen, finds himself unexpectedly tasked with unravelling the case. In a place no one can leave—and no one can reach—every guest and staff member becomes a suspect in a crime that grows more intricate and twisted by the minute.

93061.title: The Secret of Secrets
93061.overview: In The Secret of Secrets, symbologist Robert Langdon races against ancient forces and time to rescue his girlfriend, missing scientist Katherine Solomon, and her groundbreaking manuscript whose discoveries have the power to forever change humanity's understanding of the mind.

93115.title: Below
93115.overview: Calvin Penney is a big hearted but stubborn fisherman living in a small Newfoundland town, who's still haunted by his father's mysterious death from decades ago. When an unidentified sea creature begins terrorizing his hometown, Calvin must fight to hold his close-knit community together. Determined to keep his son Wade and the rest of his family safe, he teams up with a visiting marine researcher to confront the creature and reveal the island's buried secrets before it's too late. Blending local myth, thrilling suspense, and heartfelt humor, this twisty six-part limited series dives into themes of family, community, and change - both terrifying and inevitable.

93180.title: Monsters of God
93180.overview: Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love – reptiles – into the dark and gonzo underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. The billion-dollar criminal enterprise is fueled by extreme obsession for these creatures, driving many to push the boundaries of laws and environmental ethics. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails. Unfolding over decades, Monsters of God traces the evolution of the reptile trade as it skirts the Endangered Species Act of 1973 and grows into a secretive, high-stakes world of backroom dealings and fanatical collectors. With unprecedented access to the major players, from traffickers to animal enthusiasts to federal agents, Goode unravels a web of larger-than-life characters who run a complex international crime ring. A thrilling exposé of a hidden underworld, Monsters of God warns of the devastating impact of the insatiable desire for the forbidden, and how this mad obsession is pushing some species to the brink of extinction.

93184.title: Paris is Always a Good Idea
93184.originalTitle: Paris is Always a Good Idea
93184.overview: Career-driven nonprofit executive Chelsea Martin travels to Paris with her confident rival-turned-ally, Jason Knightly to secure a major donation but a heartfelt message from her late mother – and a loving push from her sister Annabelle – sends her on an unexpected journey to reconnect with the three great loves she once left behind. From the rolling hills of Ireland to the magic of Paris and the sun-kissed vineyards of Spain, Chelsea retraces old footsteps and discovers that sometimes moving forward means first looking back.

93238.title: D.O.P.E. Unit
93238.overview: A covert crime drama set in Philadelphia, following an off-the-books undercover task force known as the D.O.P.E. Unit as it wages a secret war against powerful crime families. As violence escalates and political pressure mounts, the series explores systemic corruption, moral ambiguity, and the consequences of institutional choices in a world where loyalty and justice collide. As the operation deepens, personal lives unravel, trust erodes, and every decision carries a cost that reshapes the mission and those sworn to uphold it.

93252.title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
93252.overview: Introducing a new visual approach to true crime storytelling, Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos presents next generation visualizations of documented first-person accounts from Wuornos, those close to her, and the investigators who worked the case, accounts previously available only in verified transcripts, documented evidence, and chronicled firsthand testimony. The series brings a new dimension to the story of Wuornos and the investigation that brought her to justice - through the perspectives of those who lived it.

93263.title: Yaga
93263.overview: The myth of the witch Baba Yaga is reinvigorated when a private investigator comes to a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery and finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a sexy university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives and ancient magic.

93264.title: Friends Sex and Games
93264.overview: That's what Friends Sex and Games is all about: four couples. And a sexy game that could change everything. At the center of this relationship dramedy are Anna and Paul, who've been together forever—just like their closest friends Julie, Valentin, Bella, and Leo. Their lives are running smoothly until Samu returns home with his girlfriend Siena and suggests a daring game to his old crew: the "Key Game." The rules are simple—the men toss their keys into a bowl, and the women each pick one out. Whoever draws a key spends the night with the key's owner. No strings attached, no obligations. What begins as a thrilling adventure quickly turns into an emotional powder keg. Old longings resurface, new truths come to light: Nothing stays the same. A series full of intense emotions, funny moments—and steamy sex.

93294.title: Anne Rice's Queen of the Damned
93294.originalTitle: Anne Rice's Queen of the Damned

93346.title: Engineering From Above
93346.overview: Explore some of the world's most remarkable engineering marvels. Using cutting-edge technology and dynamic graphics, we reveal iconic sites from new perspectives and uncover the secrets hidden within.

93361.title: The Airport Chaplain
93361.overview: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace has an unorthodox approach to solving the daily crises of an airport, constantly overstepping boundaries and putting him on a collision course with new boss Mira Ansari-Cole. Mira wants him fired but Tobias isn't giving up his beloved chaplaincy without a fight.

93446.title: The Varnell Hill Show
93446.overview: Nearly three decades after audiences first met him, Varnell Hill is stepping back into the spotlight - and he's determined to prove he's still the star of the show. Set behind the scenes of a long-running late-night talk show, The Varnell Hill Show follows Varnell as he fights to stay relevant in a rapidly changing entertainment landscape. Between network executives eager to modernize the show, a chaotic writers' room, celebrity guests, family drama, and his own outsized ego, Varnell quickly discovers that keeping a television empire together may be harder than building one in the first place.

93506.title: Dalliance
93506.overview: Dalliance follows retired cameraman Billy who unexpectedly crosses paths with chef Dani. An instant connection threatens to unravel decades of friendship and family. As one life-changing event sends shockwaves through an entire community, marriages are tested, new relationships ignite, old wounds resurface, and everyone is forced to confront the choices that have shaped their lives.

93548.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
93548.overview: Things rarely change, but everything began to change. Eun-tae, who has been working as an ordinary employee, is burnt out from everything that happens to him. Everything from work to relationships with others, his life is filled with boredom. Suddenly, he becomes a lottery winner and gets 1.3 billion won. While it is a huge amount, realistically, it is hard for him to even purchase his own house in Seoul. After reviewing everything, he decides to live his life as he used to, but with a somewhat different mindset, as he has "insurance" that he can depend on.

93562.title: Honor Thy Mother
93562.overview: A powerful CEO and a struggling actress from opposite worlds are forced into an unlikely partnership to rescue a company in crisis. As they fight to rebuild its reputation, old betrayals and lingering resentment resurface, putting both their fragile partnership and their chance at redemption to the ultimate test.

93569.title: Minimum Wage
93569.overview: An overwhelmed group of teenagers struggles to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss, and minimum wage salaries. The stakes are low, and the pressure is immense.

93677.title: Habeas Corpus
93677.overview: A renowned law professor leads a team of students to prove a convicted man's innocence, only to discover her brightest pupil is bound to her past.

93718.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
93718.overview: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

93728.title: Lalka
93728.overview: This stylish new take on the classic Polish novel chronicles the many attempts of an ambitious merchant to win the heart of a nobleman's daughter.

93731.title: To Catch A Smuggler: Contraband Capture
93731.originalTitle: To Catch A Smuggler: Contraband Capture
93731.overview: CBP and HSI respond to a surge in cocaine trafficking across U.S. land borders and at sea, which leads to boat chases, arrests and record-setting seizures...

93733.title: Khom Khlang
93733.overview: Bulan, a woman with a mysterious aura, crosses paths with Peem, a police officer desperate to solve a case for which the law offers no answers. Recommended as the only one capable of helping her, Bulan awakens in Peem doubts, attraction, and an unexpected bond that will challenge her beliefs and her understanding of justice.

93776.title: Paolo
93776.overview: Paolo's ordinary working-class existence is upended when he encounters the ambitious, and magnetic local politician Téophane, an old school mate. What begins as admiration and a desire to help Téophane's campaign, soon spirals into an all-consuming obsession, leading to a deadly ride in this intense psychological Ripley-style thriller.

93786.title: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena
93786.overview: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena builds upon Rice University's Center for the Impossible, one of the world's largest collections of paranormal research, by inviting everyday individuals, many of whom have never spoken publicly before, to reveal their new and personal encounters with unexplained phenomena.

93792.title: Youth
93792.overview: Youth follows a 50-year-old divorcee's search for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

93826.title: Dive into You
93826.overview: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

93837.title: Crime Scene Raw
93837.overview: Crime Scene Raw focuses on a different high-profile case each episode, utilizing police bodycam footage and forensic evidence.

93848.title: Magical Explorer
93848.overview: The legendary bishoujo game "Magical★Explorer"I was reincarnated not as the protagonist surrounded by heroines thanks to my cheat abilities, but as Takine Kousuke, the unfortunate friend character who just puts on a forced smile beside them ...!In the original game, he's inconspicuous, unrewarded, and remains a supporting character until the very end. But I have the knowledge from my past life, having played this game to its fullest extent! Furthermore, this friend character has a hidden ability: "the world's highest magical power," potentially surpassing even the protagonist...?In order to lead the heroines he has longed for and met in this world to happy endings, his friend Kousuke fights his way through this world!

93882.title: A Killer Story
93882.overview: A Killer Story examines a polarizing murder case that spanned more than two decades and captured national attention. At the center of the case is Dana Chandler, who was accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend in 2002.

93899.title: The Fixers
93899.overview: Christopher Lee and Shou Lou star as a mismatched pair of fixers for the rich and powerful, but a mysterious rival throws their mission into disarray.

93900.title: Minerva - La scuola
93900.overview: Minerva - La scuola is a teen drama series set in a military high school in Naples. It is a world that seems to belong to another era, where students are woken up at dawn for the flag-raising ceremony, where mobile phones and civilian clothes are not allowed, and where subjects include military tactics and fencing lessons. It is a world where love stories are forbidden and every mistake comes at a very high price.

93921.title: Colisión
93921.overview: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.

93941.title: The One About Matthew Perry
93941.overview: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, The One About Matthew Perry reveals the real Matthew Perry - generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life - and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon.

93969.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
93969.overview: The anime "Dragon Ball, " with original story, character designs, and concept by Akira Toriyama, is relaunched as "Dragon Ball Beerus"! This version is "enhanced," featuring a significant number of new cuts, redrawn scenes, and a restructured storyline. With the latest visual effects, this enhanced version boasts even greater realism in battle scenes and a more precise reproduction of the original manga.Several years had passed since the fierce battle with Majin Buu, and Earth had regained a brief period of peace.At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakened from his long slumber.Even the Kais and Supreme Kais watched with awe as Beerus, possessing overwhelming power capable of destroying stars, awakened... But then, having heard rumors of a Saiyan who had defeated Frieza, Beerus suddenly appeared before Goku..With Beerus, possessing unprecedented power, arriving, Earth faces the threat of annihilation... A super-intense battle that will shake the universe begins between the God of Destruction and Goku and his friends..

93997.title: Route 187
93997.overview: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

94035.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
94035.originalTitle: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
94035.overview: Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower. Dan and Suzie seek clues in spectacular castles and palaces across Britain and rest of Europe, gain rare access to archives, and reveal new evidence that helps expose the truth behind the executions. Were these iconic figures architects of their own downfall or casualties of ruthless political power plays? The series combines cinematic storytelling with cutting-edge research as we reassess some of the Tudor era's most notorious, controversial and misunderstood individuals. If you want to understand the Tudors, get to know who they executed - and why.

94415.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
94415.originalTitle: A Tale of the Secret Saint
94415.overview: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

94459.title: Africa: Earth's Wild Home
94459.overview: Africa: Earth's Wild Home captures four years of unprecedented wildlife encounters across nearly 30 countries, revealing Africa's breathtaking landscapes alongside the frontline conservationists fighting to preserve the continent's wild future.

94472.title: Paul, la série
94472.overview: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…

94560.title: Michael Palin in the Philippines
94560.overview: Michael Palin's latest adventure is an epic 2,500-mile journey across the islands of the Philippines. Known as an idyllic tropical travel hotspot, Michael also delves deeper to reveal a surprising, darker side. The legacy of Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos' spending, not just the shoes of legend but billions spent on monumental architecture, still haunts the country forty years on. Their son, Bongbong Marcos, is now President, and forty percent of the urban population lives in poverty, thirty thousand people have been lawlessly killed by vigilante anti-drug 'death squads', and a third of the country is on the UK Foreign Office 'do not travel list'. But despite all of this, Michael also experiences the Philippines as, ironically, one of the happiest and certainly the most beautiful countries he has ever visited.

94621.title: Scotland's Golden Coast
94621.overview: A joyous journey along Scotland's sublime and wildly beautiful east coast, from the Moray Firth to the Borders, as we meet the people who work and play here, and those lucky enough to call it home.

94636.title: Coffin Moon
94636.overview: Coffin Moon is set during a brutal winter in 1975 in Oregon and follows a veteran and his adopted niece as they hunt—and are hunted by—the vampire that slaughtered their family.

94658.title: Bite Size Terror
94658.overview: A bite-sized horror anthology where seemingly harmless encounters, desires, and decisions take terrifying turns.

94703.title: The Reluctant Vampire
94703.overview: Set in a timeless English village, where everything is picturesque, everything, that is, except for the vampires living in the castle on the hill who come out at night for a little drink of the locals.Val has been raised in a very typical vampire family but has always felt a bit different and hopelessly inept at rising to meet his Dad's high standards. Following a surprise encounter with his reflection, he realises he is not undead, not in the least bit.Now with a big secret to hide, Val must navigate finding out who he truly is, by mingling with the locals to learn the intricacies of their behaviour and what it means to be human. Caught between two worlds as he loves his Mum and Dad (not so much his jealous brother) and has full vampire duties expected of him by his father, whose obsession with the traditional way of life is tricky when they're undead and the villagers despise them.

94761.title: Prefiero la Muerte
94761.overview: In the quiet provincial town of Mendoza lives a misfit named Archie. One cold night, he gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

94771.title: Aileen Wuornos: Damsel of Death
94771.overview: Aileen Wuornos: Damsel of Death re-examines the crimes and life of one of America's most notorious female killers, drawing on FBI case files and testimony from Brian Jarvis, the lead detective who investigated Wuornos and questioned her following her arrest. Beginning with the murder of Richard Mallory in Florida in November 1989, the documentary traces a series of killings that left seven men dead over the following 11 months. As bodies were discovered along Florida's highways, all shot multiple times, investigators began searching for the person responsible.

94772.title: Convictions Gone Bad with Will Mellor
94772.originalTitle: Convictions Gone Bad with Will Mellor
94772.overview: Will Mellor fronts this gripping true crime series, delving into five of the most shocking miscarriages of justice in legal history. Will unpacks how the system got it so disastrously wrong and reveals the crucial new evidence that finally set the wrongfully convicted, free. We hear from the falsely accused in their own words, providing an insight into what it's like to be arrested, tried and convicted of the most horrendous of crimes; and the subsequent battle to clear their name.

94785.title: Mafia: Behind the Bloodshed
94785.overview: Mafia: Behind the Bloodshed reveals the real-world operations, structures, and history of major global organized crime groups.

94797.title: Zmora
94797.overview: A disgraced journalist returns to her hometown and sets out to investigate the unsolved disappearance of a childhood friend.
